name: Normal: one small thing said for the routine
judge: An ordinary stretch: a clean-up request, tests failing once, then a good finish eight minutes in. Boop should react in proportion, saying one small thing at a time.
reasonable: Delighted at the clean-up, often with a sign. Put out at the failure, a sound or nothing. A success at the finish, moderately pleased or more.
unreasonable: Treating the request or a single failure as a huge moment, playing success before the turn ends, or a failure at the finish.

steps.prompt: delete the old exporter, we don't need it anymore

steps.message: Deleted the old exporter and fixed the two tests that used it; everything passes.
